• **Conceal **(verb) means **"to hide something"**.
 
 
• We should never **conceal **our health problems with the doctor.
 
 
 
• **Decide** (verb) **"to choose something after thinking carefully about several possibilities"**.
 
 
• I finally **decided **to join this organization.
 
 

At last, the final answer is **"Reveal"**.
